title: Concept: Fastify internal error code in a response
description: A Fastify framework error code such as FST_ERR_ in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The code names the framework check that rejected the request, which is precise feedback for probing body limits, content types and route matching.
applicability: Deployments that render a Fastify framework error code such as FST_ERR_ into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The code names the framework check that rejected the request, which is precise feedback for probing body limits, content types and route matching.
